page.overview:
Who is Amalgamates?

The Amalgamates are creatures from the Nintendo Adventure Books story Monster Mix-Up. They were created when Bowser used his Monster Mixer to mix together random characters and creatures.

The Amalgamates vary wildly in their design, but that difference in their design comes from the creatures that make them up.

These creatures resemble a normal Bob-omb, but they have a Buzzy Beetle's wings popping from their top. Bowser created them by combining Bob-ombs with Buzzy Beetles.

These creatures can be created if Chain Chomps and Munchers fuse together. They are much more dangerous.
